title: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor planeswalker who has lost her spark, scarred and alone in the ruined Emeria Skyclave, she tries to scour Phyrexian metal from Zendikar and ends up vowing to bar all planeswalkers from her home.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, cleansed of Phyrexia and still able to planeswalk, who finds Nahiri and proposes they atone together.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The dead Phyrexian leader whom Ajani and Nahiri served as evangels.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who survived but can no longer planeswalk.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Ajani whom Nahiri says he should cry on.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker and former evangel who Ajani says is dead.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker and former evangel who Ajani says is dead.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker believed dead though no body has been found.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker believed dead though no body has been found.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped bind the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped bind the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Founder of an expedition house on Zendikar whom Nahiri once helped and plans to seek out.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped cleanse Ajani.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped cleanse Ajani.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran who helped cleanse Ajani.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Nahiri accuses Ajani of murdering.

entities.name: Emeria Skyclave
entities.description: The crashed kor ruin where Nahiri was fused into the walls, now her dark workspace.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's wrecked homeworld, covered in Phyrexian metal and oil.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city used to measure the height of Nahiri's cairn of metal.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A region the Eldrazi ate through.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The defeated invading force whose metal remains fused into Zendikar.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient horrors bound on Zendikar and later devastating Bala Ged.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's destructive upheaval, awakened when the Eldrazi were bound.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: An angelic essence that seared Nahiri before the Skyclave fell.

entities.name: Nahiri's hedron
entities.description: A delicate layered stone holding Nahiri's planeswalker spark, found in the Skyclave wall and later shattered.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The process that fused stone and metal on Zendikar and in Nahiri.

events.summary: Nahiri, now without her spark and awake after the invasion, tears Phyrexian metal from her own body and then from the Skyclave, piling it in a cairn.
events.quote: Nahiri ripped the taint of Phyrexia from her plane.

events.summary: Nahiri recalls a blast of Halo and realizes she is alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.
events.quote: The core of her power, her spark, no longer a part of her.

events.summary: A metal claw nearly stabs her and Phyrexian memories surge before she rejects them.
events.quote: That was the ghost of Phyrexia. It was not her.

events.summary: Nahiri reaches the chamber where she fused herself into the Skyclave and finds a hidden hedron containing her spark inside the wall.
Filled with hope, Nahiri tears a stairway through the Skyclave's roof and climbs out into sunlight.
Nahiri sees the extent of Phyrexia's wreckage of Zendikar and concedes it is her fault.
Nahiri resolves to restore her spark and seek help from Kesenya.
events.quote: Which meant, first things first, finding a way to restore her spark.

events.summary: Ajani appears, restored and still a planeswalker, saying he came looking for her and reporting the deaths and survivors among the former evangels.
Ajani proposes that he and Nahiri work together to make amends for what they did, and she refuses.
events.quote: "Someone needs to make amends for what we've done.

events.summary: Nahiri suspects Ajani has come to kill her as one of the former evangels.
events.quote: What if he was here to kill her?

events.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
events.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

events.summary: Nahiri flings stone to make a wall and the Skyclave dome collapses under her, dropping her onto her cairn.
events.quote: and then the dome of the Skyclave collapsed beneath her feet.

events.summary: Nahiri finds the hedron cracked and her spark gone, her last hope of regaining her power destroyed.
events.quote: Her last hope at regaining her power—at becoming a Planeswalker once more—was gone.

events.summary: Nahiri blames Planeswalkers for Zendikar's ruin and vows that none will set foot on Zendikar again.
events.quote: No Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar ever again.

relations.note: Nahiri accuses him of atrocities and blames him for ruining her last chance
relations.quote: Just as Ajani had come here, seeking her for his own selfish purposes

relations.note: Ajani seeks her out wanting to help her and atone together
relations.quote: "Because I want to help you," Ajani snarled.

relations.note: Both Nahiri and Ajani served as Norn's evangels
relations.quote: The other Planeswalkers who had been Elesh Norn's evangels.

relations.note: Ajani was Norn's most faithful evangel
relations.quote: it had been as Elesh Norn's most faithful evangel, her most favored lieutenant.

relations.note: Nahiri helped Kesenya start her expedition house
relations.quote: Nahiri had helped Kesenya start her expedition house
She was still Zendikar's guardian, after all.
They cleansed me of the taint of Phyrexia and kept me intact.
Or Chandra, she's your friend, isn't she?

relations.note: Sorin and Ugin bound the Eldrazi on Zendikar
relations.quote: Sorin and Ugin would never have been able to bind the Eldrazi in her home

relations.note: Nahiri tears Phyrexia's metal from Zendikar
relations.quote: if she could pry Phyrexia's cold, alien grip off her plane, that was good enough.
